rtt_acceptance: absolute target error <= max(10 ms, 15% of target), matching the packet-loss and combined-network operational gate; exact qdisc configuration is authoritative
goodput_scope: iperf3 receiver payload average over four measured seconds after four omitted preconditioning seconds, independently per direction
goodput_gate_revision: Frozen before the definitive experiment after excluded runs showed that one omitted second did not leave TCP steady at high bandwidth-delay product
rate_scope: per direction; same TBF rate on client and server egress
tbf_burst_policy: max(1600 bytes, ten milliseconds of configured rate); conservative rate/HZ sizing with HZ=100
